# v1.6.3 — In-app Android updater

- Added an **Ažuriranja** section to mobile settings showing the installed version and checking GitHub Releases for a newer APK.
- Added download-and-install flow with live progress, a streamed download, and a size sanity check before handing the APK to Android’s package installer.
- Declared the Android install permission so users can allow installs from the app when prompted.
- Added semver-style version comparison and unit coverage.
- Added `package_info_plus` for installed app version information.

## Verification

- Flutter analysis and updater tests passed; a local release APK was built (53 MB).
